mechanism: Both drugs cause CNS depression through opioid and dopamine antagonist mechanisms, and prochlorperazine may inhibit hydrocodone metabolism via CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, increasing opioid levels.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use lowest effective doses, monitor closely for respiratory depression, sedation, and altered mental status, and counsel on avoiding alcohol and other CNS depressants.
